integrity: The symbolic facet classification and angular expectation identities have explicit analytic proofs. A standalone Python standard-library checker reproduces 21,151 generic exact sign instances, all listed support witnesses, and six Monte Carlo expectation checks; finite tests are not substituted for continuum proofs.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats generic central planar sections in a single three-dimensional one-parameter family, not special vertex-containing sections or arbitrary centrally symmetric bodies. It supplies complete vertex-count support, exact orientation inequalities, and Haar expectation, but not all individual type probabilities. No independent priority or mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Unique octagonal-section rigidity and sharp mean along the cube–octahedron interpolation
